title: Christmas Update
description: A Vanilla styled christmas update for minecraft
body:
> Mod Content:
> 
> - Brand new woodset called cinnamon wood
> - Brand new plant called peppermint plant
> - Present wrapping that you can shift-rightclick on a chest to turn it into a present and use - shears to turn it  back into a chest (WARNING: right clicking a present will drop all the items inside but will not give present wrapping or chest nor will breaking it)
> - Gingerbread cookies made of sugar wheat and cinnamon
> - Sugar Icing that you can use on gingerbread cookies or Cinnamon roll
> - 4 types of hot chocolate, normal hot chocolate, hot chocolate with candy cane, hot chocolate with marshmallows and hot chocolate with marshmallows and candy cane
> 
> Mod Guide:
> 
> - Get cinnamon by stripping a cinnamon log dropping cinnamon bark that can be smelted into cinnamon
> - Get peppermint powder by finding peppermint plant in taigas and snowy taigas and breaking it  to get peppermint leafs that you can craft into peppermint powder
> 
> Plans:
> 
> - Currently there are 3 unavailable mobs in this mod, white iced gingerbread man, red iced - gingerbread man and green iced gingerbread man. They will be available sometime in the future for now you can spawn them in creative using the spawn eggs in the creative tab.
>
> **Credits:**
> - If you use this mod in a modpack please Credit me!
>
